finding.publisher_fail_closed_improvement: Current source rejects promotion eligibility for a dirty tracked worktree or entrypoint blob mismatch while still allowing bounded research execution.
finding.remaining_gap: The active supervisor start_forge path still treats any pgrep match for run_free_evidence_forge_backfill.py as sufficient to return. It does not read FORGE_LIVE.json runtime_identity, compare the live writer identity to the expected entrypoint/source/process generation, require a non-null supervisor start nonce, or restart on missing/mismatched identity.
finding.why_material: A stale or alternate backlog-first process can therefore survive supervisor reconciliation even though the publisher schema is capable of distinguishing it. Generic process-name presence remains weaker than exact executable/source/process identity.

counterhypothesis.claim: The publisher-side identity envelope alone is sufficient because only one backlog-first process name is allowed.
counterhypothesis.reason: pgrep establishes a matching command name, not the status writer's exact bytes, checkout identity, process generation, or supervisor generation; the supervisor currently does not consume the stronger identity it already receives.

successor_contract.supervisor_start_nonce: Mint one nonce per Forge spawn/reconciliation generation and pass it as CLAY_SUPERVISOR_GENERATION_NONCE.
successor_contract.expected_identity: Bind expected entrypoint path/hash plus admitted source commit/tree before spawn.
successor_contract.fresh_status_gate: After spawn/reconciliation require one fresh FORGE_LIVE.json whose CLAY_FORGE_RUNTIME_IDENTITY/v1 matches expected source/entrypoint/nonce and source_identity_admitted=true.

successor_contract.process_generation: Prefer Linux /proc process-start generation binding or an equivalently replay-resistant process generation in addition to PID; do not rely on PID alone.
minimum_regressions: process-name match without matching status identity rejected
